page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs provided by a Hygon 7447v processor operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Because it features dedicated CPU allocation, it avoids resource contention issues common in shared-core environments, offering predictable compute performance. From a resource-density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as an efficient option for workloads that require dedicated processing power without the overhead of large memory footprints.

This hardware configuration is suited for lightweight compute-focused applications, basic web serving, microservices, and small-scale utility tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU execution but do not require local storage or high memory capacity.
